currentParagraphText: “Such untoward thoughts would never even dare cross my mind,” Jake said with a stoic look as he put away the fragment before smiling. “Thanks. I do owe you one for helping out here today, no matter what. I also hope it won’t be a problem that you helped me fight the Holy Church despite being a part of Valhal.”
